fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s civic development and the need for coordinated progress; prohibition enforcement and international complications involving U.S. Coast Guard actions and an apology to Great Britain; downtown traffic and double-parking problems; rising milk prices and calls for more coordinated dairy regulation and pasteurization across Dade County municipalities; discussion of naming the new Dade County courthouse/administration building; Coral Gables commission politics and the selection of Alfred K. Simmons; and assorted local columns, society/nightlife notes, entertainment listings, and advertisements (including telephone service and ice company promotions).
